title: ^ETHICS IN ORGANIZATIONS
description: Develops business professional skills in individual moral self-awareness and organizational ethical analysis in order to examine, diagnose, and navigate ethically relevant work situations.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (COMM 111, 111H, 111Z, 111HZ, 114, 114H, 218, 218H, 218Z or 218HZ) and (WR 222, 222H, 227Z, 227HZ, 323, 323H, 327, 327H or HC 199).
A minimum grade of C- is required in COMM 111, COMM 111H, COMM 111Z, COMM 111HZ, COMM 114, COMM 114H, COMM 218, COMM 218H, COMM 218Z, COMM 218HZ, WR 222, WR 222H, WR 227Z, WR 227HZ, WR 323, WR 323H, WR 327, WR 327H and HC 199.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Management (196)
  • Apparel Design (400)
  • Pre-Apparel (453)
  • Pre-Interiors (454)
  • Interior Design (458)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
  • Organizational Leadership (C190)
